headline: RASKIN WIDENS
dek: Nov. 23 letters ask Hadrian, Juul, Polymarket and GrabAGun for records due Dec. 7, AP reports.

nodes.text: 1789 Capital invests in Hadrian, an AI-and-robotics defense manufacturer.
Rep. Jamie Raskin, the ranking Democrat on House Judiciary, opens a probe of 1789 Capital.
Raskin sends letters to Hadrian, Juul, Polymarket and GrabAGun seeking records tied to 1789 Capital, due Dec. 7.
ProPublica reports the Pentagon is weighing a $15 billion loan to Hadrian. The Pentagon disputes the figure.

means.label: The letters:
means.text: They seek communications with 1789 Capital, plus investment agreements, valuations and due-diligence files.

means.label: 1789 Capital:
means.text: Attorney Bill Burck told Fox Business, “These are personal attacks untethered to actual evidence.”

means.label: The probe:
means.text: Raskin is examining whether the firm helped steer federal contracts or regulatory decisions, or used advance knowledge of them, House Judiciary Democrats said.

sources: Sources: AP; House Judiciary Democrats letters, Nov. 23; Fox Business; ProPublica, Nov. 24.
